email.title: SUPLA Email
email.description: Email used to log in to SUPLA mobile app/cloud.

password.title: SUPLA Password
password.description: Password used to log in to SUPLA mobile app/cloud.

server.title: Server Override
server.description: Optional SUPLA cloud server hostname or URL. If omitted, autodiscover is used.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (s)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often channel states are refreshed from SUPLA cloud.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for SUPLA cloud HTTP requests.

includeHidden.title: Include Hidden Channels
includeHidden.description: Expose channels that are hidden in SUPLA cloud.
